title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, start by drawing the first line from the origin at (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0). Continue with the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0469), then the third line from (0.75, 0.0469) to (0.7031, 0.0938). Follow this with the fourth line from (0.7031, 0.0938) to (0.0469, 0.0938), the fifth line from (0.0469, 0.0938) to (0.0, 0.0469), and finally, the sixth line from (0.0, 0.0469) back to the origin at (0.0, 0.0). After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.0375 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism with rounded edges are 0.7500000000000001 units in length, 0.09375000000000001 units in width, and 0.0375 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch points
points = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.0469),
    (0.7031, 0.0938),
    (0.0469, 0.0938),
    (0.0, 0.0469),
    (0.0, 0.0)
]

# Create the sketch
r = r.polyline(points).close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0375)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.7500   # X
W = 0.0938   # Y
T = 0.0375   # Z

# Chamfer size on the corners (seen in TOP view)
c = 0.0300

# Profile in XY plane: rectangle with chamfered corners at both ends
points = [
    (c, 0.0),
    (L - c, 0.0),
    (L, c),
    (L, W - c),
    (L - c, W),
    (c, W),
    (0.0, W - c),
    (0.0, c),
]

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polyline(points)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Chamfer offset (45-degree corner cuts on the back edge in the top view)
c = 0.0938 / 2  # 0.0469

# Sketch the hexagonal XY profile: rectangle with both back corners chamfered
r = cq.Workplane("XY") \
    .moveTo(0, 0) \
    .lineTo(0.75, 0) \
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0938 - c) \
    .lineTo(0.75 - c, 0.0938) \
    .lineTo(c, 0.0938) \
    .lineTo(0, 0.0938 - c) \
    .close() \
    .extrude(0.0375)
